itemList.description: Cleaning concrete / masonry / rock surface for guniting / shotcreting by sand blasting method and cleaning by air and water jets after sandblasting as per specifications including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding etc., complete with all lead and all lifts.

Drilling holes of 14mm dia. up to 150mm deep over upstream face of Dam at 600mm c/c both ways or as directed without damaging the structure by using non-vibrated electrical drilling machines for fixing 10mm dia. shear connectors including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding charges, etc., complete as directed by Engineer in charge.

Providing & fixing 10mm dia. Torsteel pins / shear connectors of length 200mm embedded to a depth of 150 mm into the upstream face of the Dam with projection of 50mm from the upstream surface of Dam in drilled holes after flushing & cleaning the holes.Anchoring the steel pins to the upstream face of the Dam by using polyester resin anchor grout of approved make or any other suitable approved grout and conducting pull out tests randomly as directed after necessary hardening including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding with all lead and lifts etc., complete as directed by the Engineer in charge.(a) For fixing 10mm dia. Pins

Providing & fixing 10mm dia. Torsteel pins / shear connectors of length 200mm embedded to a depth of 150 mm into the upstream face of the Dam with projection of 50mm from the upstream surface of Dam in drilled holes after flushing & cleaning the holes.Anchoring the steel pins to the upstream face of the Dam by using polyester resin anchor grout of approved make or any other suitable approved grout and conducting pull out tests randomly as directed after necessary hardening including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding with all lead and lifts etc., complete as directed by the Engineer in charge.(b) For conducting pull out tests

Providing, fabricating & fixing welded mesh / steel mats (like BRC) of 4.2mm bar dia. or as directed with clear spacing of 75mm both ways and placed 30mm from the upstream surface of Dam and fixed firmly by welding to the steel pins provided to the upstream surface as directed including cleaning the reinforcement, straightening, bending, welding including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding with all lead and lifts etc., complete as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Providing dry shot creting of 50 mm thick in one layer of M30 grade having cube compressive strength of 30 N/mm at 28 days as per IS 9012 - 1978 - 1997 or latest revision for upstream face of Dam using Cement, FA and 6mm MSA in required proportion by weight (1:2:1 by dry mix process), water cement ratio less than 0.50 by adding non shrink grout compound and suitable water proofing chemical over cleaned surface of the upstream surface and without disturbing the welded mesh (shotcrete should not be screeded or worked in any way, once in place), including cost of all materials, approved templates of steel / aluminium / fibre glass or heavy duty plastic, labour, machinery, scaffolding, curing(curing shall be done by fixing perforated pipes all along the shotcreted area using suitable pump), cleaning and disposing off the excess / rebound materials with all lead and lifts etc., complete as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Providing pointing to exposed face of masonry 75mm deep in cement mortar 1:3 proportion by weight in two stages with approved water proof compound at 2% by weight of cement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, raking and cleaning joints, curing etc., complete with all leads and lifts. (For D/s face of Dam)

Colour video monitoring wherever directed including covering all activities viz chipping / raking to the required depth, cleaning of joints by brushing using pneumatic tools and underwater plugging of suction points, filling of sand particles, fixing of nipples using necessary equipments such as underwater video camera monitoring unit with surface TV set for display at top with reference to marking grids on the face of dam including cost of all equipments, labours, divers, colour video recording also should be done for a period of 05 hours covering the above activities wherever directed and delivery of 4 sets of recorded CD etc., as directed by Engineer in charge.

Identifying and plugging the suction points on U/s face of dam around porous pipes where the shotcreting not carried out and heavy seepage is observed with cementatious non shrink, rapid setting, multipurpose compound, including cost of diving and communication, fixing of nozzles wherever required, cost of all materials, scafolding, labour, machinaries, etc complete with all lead and lifts when the water is non depleted in the reservoir as per the directions of Engineer in charge.

Drilling of 40 to 50mm dia. holes (non - coring) by rotary method in rock, masonry or concrete including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides etc., complete with all lead and lifts (excluding cost of cement).
